projects.title: SolarUp
projects.description:
A web application to help companies and parking lot owners determine the economic viability of installing solar panel roofs on their parking lots. Users can enter in the address and dimensions of their proposed parking lot in order to learn profitability, expected time to receive net profit, and solar energy produced.

Created at HackHarvard 2023; placed runner-up in Earth and Space Track and Best Domain Name.

projects.title: Code Flow
projects.description:
An artificial intelligence based service that creates individual new hire's onboarding process easier and more efficient. Users can transform their large company code repositories into visualizations and interact with a Cohere-powered chat bot to understand their company's codebase better.

Created at Hack the North 2023 within a 36 hour timeframe; placed 3rd in Cohere's Best Use of Cohere track
